name: update-intent
description: Update AGENTS.md intent nodes only when a diff changes a durable module contract, ownership rule, dependency boundary, architectural pattern, or project-wide invariant. Use when explicitly asked to refresh intent documentation or when those structural changes make existing guidance inaccurate; do not use for ordinary commits, bug fixes, tuning, thresholds, benchmark results, or implementation details. Accepts an optional git range such as main..HEAD or HEAD~5.
